name: rundossier
description: Preframe B2B prospect research and personalization pipeline

scripts.fix-encoding: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; Get-ChildItem -Recurse src -Filter *.ts | ForEach-Object { $b = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($_.FullName); if ($b.Length -ge 2 -and $b[1] -eq 0) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($_.FullName, [IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName, [Text.Encoding]::Unicode), $utf8); Write-Host Fixed $_.Name } }"
